intent: Write JUnit 5 + AssertJ tests (reactor-test StepVerifier for Mono/Flux, Mockito for collaborators, no external services, no Thread.sleep) for AuditEntry. Assert ONLY against the ast_hints method table; at least one given/when/then case per table method and per branch. Unit contract: Shared audit trail record: actor, action, outcome (SUCCESS|FAILURE), timestamp, correlationId (the requestId). Immutable record; the outcome literals SUCCESS and FAILURE are owned here and consumers pin this unit.

methods.signature: AuditEntry(String actor, AuditAction action, String outcome, Instant timestamp, String correlationId)
methods.semantics: Null rejected (NullPointerException); actor and correlationId non-blank; outcome is exactly SUCCESS or FAILURE (IllegalArgumentException otherwise).
